name: Reduce to Memory (Recharge 6)
description: Thundering golden energy erupts around a creature the creature can see within 90 feet of it. The creature must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 33 (6d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Construct has disadvantage on the saving throw.
